newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Four Seas raises funds for China ventures.
newsitem.headline: Four Seas raises funds for China ventures.

text.p: Four Seas Mercantile Holdings Ltd is issuing 30 million new shares to raise funds to finance its China projects, the company said in a statement published on Friday.

The major shareholder of the company would place 30 million new shares at a price of HK$4.125 to professional and institutional investors, then subscribe for the same number of new shares, a company statement said.
The placing price represented a 7.3 percent discount to the share's closing price of HK$4.45 on Thursday, March 13. The placing was expected to be completed by March 18, it said.
The company would raise HK$122 million net of expenses to fund the company's joint venture projects in China and for general working capital, the statement.
The placing shares represented 11.1 percent of the company's existing share capital of 270 million shares, and approximately 10 percent of the enlarged issued share capital.
Following the placement and issue of new shares, the seller of the placement shares Careful Guide Ltd and parties acting with it would own 60.83 percent of Four Seas share capital.
